limitations: single stationary pose cannot distinguish accelerometer bias from mechanical tilt
horizontal mounting axes require manual tilt or independent orientation reference
bias is from one powered session; temperature/restart repeatability not yet measured
X/Y alignment is based on user manual confirmation; mixed nose-up capture is not accepted as a controlled three-axis mounting test

axis_assessment.x_positive: vehicle forward, manually confirmed by user
axis_assessment.y_positive: vehicle left, manually confirmed by user
axis_assessment.z_positive: up, inferred from stationary specific force and corrected user interpretation
axis_assessment.z_down_report_explanation: User confirmed they inferred down-positive from resting +9.8 and downward gravity; this does not mean the accelerometer positive axis points down.
